question: For the email lists subscribed by faculty members with last names begin with Y, list the names of the lists, the total number of subjects managed by faculty in those mailing lists, and the number of such faculty in the lists.

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE materializer_assumption_check AS
WITH cols AS (
SELECT 'moira_list' AS table_name, name AS column_name, type AS data_type, pk AS is_pk FROM pragma_table_info('moira_list') ORDER BY cid
UNION ALL
SELECT 'moira_list_detail' AS table_name, name AS column_name, type AS data_type, pk AS is_pk FROM pragma_table_info('moira_list_detail') ORDER BY cid
UNION ALL
SELECT 'hr_faculty_roster' AS table_name, name AS column_name, type AS data_type, pk AS is_pk FROM pragma_table_info('hr_faculty_roster') ORDER BY cid
UNION ALL
SELECT 'subject_offered_summary' AS table_name, name AS column_name, type AS data_type, pk AS is_pk FROM pragma_table_info('subject_offered_summary') ORDER BY cid
), expected AS (
    SELECT * FROM (VALUES
        ('moira_list','moira_list_key'),
        ('moira_list','moira_list_name'),
        ('moira_list_detail','moira_list_key'),
        ('moira_list_detail','moira_list_member_mit_id'),
        ('hr_faculty_roster','mit_id'),
        ('hr_faculty_roster','last_name'),
        ('subject_offered_summary','responsible_faculty_mit_id'),
        ('subject_offered_summary','subject_id')
    ) AS t(table_name, expected_column)
)
SELECT e.table_name,
       e.expected_column,
       CASE WHEN c.column_name IS NOT NULL THEN 'present' ELSE 'MISSING' END AS status,
       c.data_type
FROM expected e
LEFT JOIN cols c
  ON c.table_name = e.table_name AND c.column_name = e.expected_column
ORDER BY e.table_name, e.expected_column;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH y_faculty AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CAST(mit_id AS BIGINT) AS mit_id
    FROM hr_faculty_roster
    WHERE mit_id IS NOT NULL
      AND last_name ILIKE 'Y%'
),
list_faculty AS (
    SELECT d.moira_list_key,
           CAST(d.moira_list_member_mit_id AS BIGINT) AS mit_id
    FROM moira_list_detail d
    WHERE d.moira_list_member_mit_id IS NOT NULL
),
list_y_faculty AS (
    SELECT lf.moira_list_key, lf.mit_id
    FROM list_faculty lf
    INNER JOIN y_faculty yf ON lf.mit_id = yf.mit_id
),
subjects_by_faculty AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CAST(responsible_faculty_mit_id AS BIGINT) AS mit_id,
           subject_id
    FROM subject_offered_summary
    WHERE responsible_faculty_mit_id IS NOT NULL
),
list_subjects AS (
    SELECT lyf.moira_list_key,
           sbf.subject_id
    FROM list_y_faculty lyf
    INNER JOIN subjects_by_faculty sbf ON lyf.mit_id = sbf.mit_id
),
agg AS (
    SELECT ls.moira_list_key,
           COUNT(DISTINCT ls.subject_id) AS total_subjects_managed,
           COUNT(DISTINCT lyf.mit_id) AS num_y_faculty
    FROM list_subjects ls
    INNER JOIN list_y_faculty lyf ON ls.moira_list_key = lyf.moira_list_key
    GROUP BY ls.moira_list_key
)
SELECT ml.moira_list_name AS list_name,
       a.total_subjects_managed,
       a.num_y_faculty
FROM agg a
JOIN moira_list ml ON a.moira_list_key = ml.moira_list_key
ORDER BY list_name
LIMIT 200;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH y_faculty AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CAST(mit_id AS BIGINT) AS mit_id
    FROM hr_faculty_roster
    WHERE mit_id IS NOT NULL AND last_name ILIKE 'Y%'
),
w_faculty AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CAST(mit_id AS BIGINT) AS mit_id
    FROM hr_faculty_roster
    WHERE mit_id IS NOT NULL AND last_name ILIKE 'W%'
),
list_faculty AS (
    SELECT d.moira_list_key, CAST(d.moira_list_member_mit_id AS BIGINT) AS mit_id
    FROM moira_list_detail d
    WHERE d.moira_list_member_mit_id IS NOT NULL
),
list_y AS (
    SELECT lf.moira_list_key, lf.mit_id FROM list_faculty lf JOIN y_faculty yf ON lf.mit_id = yf.mit_id
),
list_w AS (
    SELECT lf.moira_list_key, lf.mit_id FROM list_faculty lf JOIN w_faculty wf ON lf.mit_id = wf.mit_id
),
use_w AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM list_y) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS flag
),
base AS (
    SELECT * FROM list_y
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM list_w WHERE (SELECT flag FROM use_w)=1
),
subjects_by_faculty AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CAST(responsible_faculty_mit_id AS BIGINT) AS mit_id, subject_id
    FROM subject_offered_summary
    WHERE responsible_faculty_mit_id IS NOT NULL
)

       COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT sbf.subject_id),0) AS total_subjects_managed,
       COUNT(DISTINCT b.mit_id) AS num_faculty
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN subjects_by_faculty sbf ON b.mit_id = sbf.mit_id
JOIN moira_list ml ON b.moira_list_key = ml.moira_list_key
GROUP BY ml.moira_list_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b.mit_id) > 0
ORDER BY list_name
LIMIT 200;

WITH ed AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CAST(mit_id AS BIGINT) AS mit_id,
         LOWER(TRIM(krb_name)) AS krb,
         LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(email_address, '^\s+|\s+$', '')) AS email,
         UPPER(TRIM(last_name)) AS last_name
  FROM employee_directory
  WHERE mit_id IS NOT NULL
),
edd AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CAST(mit_id AS BIGINT) AS mit_id,
         LOWER(TRIM(krb_name)) AS krb,
         LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(email_address, '^\s+|\s+$', '')) AS email,
         UPPER(TRIM(last_name)) AS last_name
  FROM drupal_employee_directory
  WHERE mit_id IS NOT NULL
),
people AS (
  SELECT mit_id, krb, email, last_name FROM ed
  UNION ALL
  SELECT mit_id, krb, email, last_name FROM edd
),
people_norm AS (
  SELECT mit_id,
         /* derive kerberos from email if missing */
         COALESCE(krb,
                  CASE WHEN email LIKE '%@%'
                       THEN SPLIT_PART(email,'@',1) END) AS krb,
         last_name
  FROM people
),
faculty AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CAST(mit_id AS BIGINT) AS mit_id,
         UPPER(TRIM(last_name)) AS last_name
  FROM hr_faculty_roster
  WHERE mit_id IS NOT NULL
),

  SELECT DISTINCT CAST(responsible_faculty_mit_id AS BIGINT) AS mit_id,
         subject_id
  FROM subject_offered_summary
  WHERE responsible_faculty_mit_id IS NOT NULL
),
ml_members AS (
  SELECT d.moira_list_key,
         LOWER(TRIM(d.moira_list_member)) AS member_token
  FROM moira_list_detail d
  WHERE d.moira_list_member IS NOT NULL
),
-- Join Moira member token to kerberos in directory (common in Moira)
member_to_person AS (
  SELECT m.moira_list_key, p.mit_id, f.last_name
  FROM ml_members m
  JOIN people_norm p ON m.member_token = p.krb
  JOIN faculty f ON p.mit_id = f.mit_id
),
member_y AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT moira_list_key, mit_id
  FROM member_to_person
  WHERE last_name LIKE 'Y%'
),
agg AS (
  SELECT my.moira_list_key,
         COUNT(DISTINCT my.mit_id) AS num_y_faculty,
         COUNT(DISTINCT s.subject_id) AS total_subjects_managed
  FROM member_y my
  LEFT JOIN subjects_by_faculty s ON my.mit_id = s.mit_id
  GROUP BY my.moira_list_key
)
SELECT ml.moira_list_name AS list_name,
       a.total_subjects_managed,
       a.num_y_faculty
FROM agg a
JOIN moira_list ml ON a.moira_list_key = ml.moira_list_key
ORDER BY list_name
LIMIT 200;

member_y AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT moira_list_key, mit_id
  FROM member_to_person
  WHERE last_name LIKE 'Y%'
),
subjects_by_faculty AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CAST(responsible_faculty_mit_id AS BIGINT) AS mit_id, subject_id
  FROM subject_offered_summary
  WHERE responsible_faculty_mit_id IS NOT NULL
),
agg AS (
  SELECT my.moira_list_key,
         COUNT(DISTINCT my.mit_id) AS num_y_faculty,
         COUNT(DISTINCT s.subject_id) AS total_subjects_managed
  FROM member_y my
  LEFT JOIN subjects_by_faculty s ON my.mit_id = s.mit_id
  GROUP BY my.moira_list_key
),
counts AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS lists_with_y_faculty,
         COALESCE(SUM(total_subjects_managed),0) AS total_subjects_across_lists,
         COALESCE(SUM(num_y_faculty),0) AS total_y_faculty_across_lists
  FROM agg
)
SELECT 
  CASE WHEN lists_with_y_faculty IS NULL OR lists_with_y_faculty = 0 THEN 'No matching lists found' ELSE 'Matching lists exist' END AS status,
  COALESCE(lists_with_y_faculty,0) AS lists_with_y_faculty,
  COALESCE(total_subjects_across_lists,0) AS total_subjects_across_lists,
  COALESCE(total_y_faculty_across_lists,0) AS total_y_faculty_across_lists
FROM counts;
'''
